objective_text: Describe that cells are the basic unit of structure and function in living things.
Explain how groups of cells form tissues that perform specific functions.
Interpret diagrams that show how body systems interact to carry out functions.
Identify which organs belong to specific body systems in a model.
Describe structures in organisms that increase chances of survival and reproduction.
Use examples to explain how behaviors can help organisms survive and reproduce.
Explain that sensory receptors detect different types of stimuli from the environment.
Describe how signals from receptors are processed by the nervous system to produce responses.
Describe how environmental factors like light affect plant growth and reproduction.
Interpret data from simple experiments on plant growth under different conditions.
